title: Simintin siminti, busasshen yumbu da fasaha da aka samo, an yi shi lafiya
course_title: Babban Kayan Ado na Gida & Haɓakawa

say: Simintin siminti, busasshen yumbu da fasaha da aka samo, an yi shi lafiya.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don samfura uku na Babban Kayan Gida da Upcycling.
Siminti, busasshen yumbu da abubuwan da aka samo suna ba ku damar yin ingantattun kayan adon: masu shuka shuki, masu riƙon kyandir, jita-jita na kayan kwalliya da sassa na bango.

panel.heading: M, kayan ado sassaka
items: Masu shuka shuki da masu riƙe kyandir a cikin siminti
Jita-jita da plaques a cikin busasshen yumbu
Fasahar bango daga abubuwan da aka samo
Daidaitaccen gaurayawan da amintaccen mu'amala

say: Wannan tsarin yana koyar da daidaitattun haɗe-haɗe, gyare-gyare daga kwantena, amintaccen sarrafa siminti, da yadda ake haɗa abubuwa cikin fasaha.

say: Rigar siminti yana da ƙarfi alkaline. Yana iya kona fata, kuma kura tana harzuka idanu da huhu. Saka safofin hannu masu hana ruwa, tabarau, abin rufe fuska don busasshen foda, da dogon hannun riga. Tsare yara da dabbobi nesa.

panel.heading: Siminti na iya ƙone fata da idanu

cards.d: Safofin hannu masu hana ruwa, tabarau masu aminci, abin rufe fuska don busassun foda, dogon hannun riga. Mix a waje.
A wanke fata da sauri da ruwa mai tsabta. Idanu: kurkura aƙalla mintuna 15 kuma ku nemi taimakon likita.
Kada a taɓa kurkura siminti zuwa magudanun ruwa. Bari ragowar ta yi tauri, a jefar da su a matsayin sharar gida.

say: Idan jikakken siminti ya sami fata, a wanke shi da sauri da ruwa mai tsabta. Idan ya shiga cikin idanu, a wanke da ruwa mai tsabta na akalla mintuna 15, sannan a nemi taimakon likita.

say: Hudu suna buƙatar lita 2. Rigar haɗuwa yana raguwa idan aka kwatanta da busassun kayan abinci, don haka ta shirya game da lita 2.5 na busassun abu.

panel.rule: Siminti yana taurare da ruwa, ba ta bushewa ba. Ajiye shi.

say: Ruwan busasshen iska yana taurare a dakin da zafin jiki, don haka ba ku buƙatar kiln. Ya dace da jita-jita na trinket, plaques da ƙananan vases.

panel.heading: Laka biyu, babu kiln da ake buƙata
left: Shigo da shi, zai iya yin tsada
right: Mafi kyau ga ƙananan cikakkun bayanai
Mai arha, ana siyar da shi cikin gida

say: Cold Pocelain shine masara kofi 1, 1 kofin PVA manne, cokali 1 na mai da cokali 1 na ruwan 'ya'yan itace lemun tsami ko vinegar, an motsa shi akan zafi kadan. Yi amfani da tukunyar da aka ajiye kawai don sana'a daga baya, bar kullu ya yi sanyi kafin a sarrafa, kuma a nisantar da yara daga murhu.

say: Misali, Rahila a Makurdi tana mirgine wani katako mai kauri na mm 5 a tsakanin igiya biyu na katako, ta danna tsohuwar yadin da aka saka a ciki, sannan ta yanke da'ira shida tare da kofin santimita 10.

say: Tana yafa kowanne a cikin miya mai layi sannan ta bushe su a hankali a ƙarƙashin wani sako-sako, tana juya su bayan ranar farko.

say: Haɗuwa fasaha ce da aka yi ta hanyar gyara abubuwan da aka samo akan ƙasa. Anyi mugun abu, yayi kama da tarkacen manna. Don haka ajiye komai a bushe, nemo wuri guda ɗaya, maimaita launi, bar wani sarari mara komai, sannan a ɗauki hoto kowane shimfida.

say: Don tunawa. Kare fata, idanunka da huhu daga siminti, kuma kiyaye jifa da jiƙa har tsawon mako guda. Yankan yumbu don busassun abubuwa ne kawai. Ajiye assemblages kafin mannewa, kuma rataya guda masu nauyi tare da D-zobba da waya.
